title: Real Laminations of Cubic Polynomials on Boundaries of Hyperbolic Components
summary: Milnor divides all bounded hyperbolic components of cubic polynomials into 4 types (A), (B), (C) and (D). In this article, we characterize the real laminations of cubic polynomials on the tame boundary of all bounded hyperbolic components of type (A), (B), or (C). For such maps, we prove that the real lamination is the smallest lamination which contains the real lamination of maps in the hyperbolic component and an equivalence relation generated by one characteristic equivalence class.
